newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up slightly vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up slightly vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.2956 on Friday from Thursday's 8.2958 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai, traders said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2955.
The yuan opened up at an intraday high of 8.2950 and hit a low of 8.2958 early in the trading before it stayed around 8.2956 for the rest of the session.
Trading was as active as Thursday, with most done at 8.2956, traders said.
One dealer said the yuan was still capped firmly at about 8.2950 but no factors would push it down further below 8.2960.
"What this week's trend shows is that the yuan will have a difficult time breaking out of this narrow range early next week," he added.
The yuan closed up sharply at 6.7150 from 6.8089 against 100 Japanese yen in line with the yen's falls in the world market.
The yuan closed up at an intraday high of 1.0710 from 1.0722 against the Hong Kong dollar.
